messages:
alex: Hey team — PR 5421 is blocked by docs-preview. Linkcheck failing on the migration guide (anchor moved) + vale flagged a passive-voice warning we didn't have before. Can someone pick this up?

ci-bot: docs-preview build failed for PR 5421 (job: linkcheck). Logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/5421/logs

docs-bot: vale report: 1 new issue: styles.passive-voice -> please reword sentence in migration.md: 'the migration was completed' -> 'we completed the migration'

mia: I can take the anchor/linkcheck part. Looks like the anchor changed from #upgrade-steps to #upgrade-paths in the source -> quick patch should update the internal link.

jon: I'll pick the vale passive voice edit. Short wording tweak, no API changes. Planning to push a tiny commit in ~20m.

alex: Thanks both — also heads up we have the 12:00 merge window, so if CI is green before then we can merge. If not, we may need to schedule a follow-up slot.

sam: To rerun preview once fixes are pushed: comment `@ci-bot rerun docs-preview` or trigger from the PR checks page. If you want, I can kick a rerun after Mia's patch lands. :thumbsup:

mia: Pushed link fix in a11y-friendly way: replaced relative anchor and added an HTML anchor fallback for older links. Diff: https://git.example.com/r/redwood/docs/+/5421/files#diff-3

jon: Pushed wording tweak addressing vale. I ran `vale --config .vale.ini docs/migration.md` locally and it passes. Commit 7f3e9b4.

sam: Rerun kicked (requested by @alex). ci-bot: rerun queued.

ci-bot: docs-preview started for PR 5421 (run id 8842).

ci-bot: docs-preview passed (linkcheck + vale + md-lint) — all green.

alex: Awesome. Who's merging?

mia: I can merge during the 12:00 window. I'll squash and merge with the commit message: "fix(docs): link + style fixes for migration guide (PR 5421)"

jon: Thanks! Can you also add a quick changelog blurb under docs/CHANGELOG.md noting the anchor rename? Small note so customers following the migration guide aren't surprised.

mia: Yep will add a one-line note before merging.

mia: Merged at 1723456950. :rocket:
